subject: loop: a reply that is a tool's arguments printed as text gets a real call, not a finish
prompt:
A run can end on a tool call the model printed instead of making. On a free route, gpt-oss:120b answered a question about a file with the whole reply `{"paths": ["csv.ts"]}` and then `end_turn`: nothing ran, and the run finished after one completion on a task it never started. The agent loop (packages/orchestrator/src/agent-loop.ts) accepts any text-only `end_turn` as the answer.

What should happen: when a text-only reply is exactly the argument object of one advertised tool — a JSON object (and nothing else) whose every key is a property declared in that tool's input schema and which carries every required property — the loop keeps the reply in the transcript, names the tool back to the model in a user message saying the reply was the tool's arguments "printed as text" and asking it to call the tool, reports a warning notice, and continues the run. At most twice per run; after that the reply stands as the answer. Prose that merely contains JSON, arrays, empty objects, objects with an undeclared key or a missing required key, and replies when no tools are advertised are not affected.

The nudge message is appended with the transcript origin `nudge:misencoded-call` (the loop already tags its other nudges with an origin, which `AgentLoop#originOf` reads back).

Keep the existing exported APIs working, and keep the existing tests passing.

Interface the fix must provide:
- `misencodedToolCall(text: string, tools: ReadonlyArray<ToolDefinition>): string | null`, exported from packages/orchestrator/src/agent-loop.ts — the name of the one advertised tool whose input schema the text's object fits as described above, or null.
